newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore noon stocks up but confidence shaky.
newsitem.headline: Singapore noon stocks up but confidence shaky.

text.p: The Singapore stock market was a little firmer at midday on Wednesday but dealers said a lack of investor confidence capped upside potential.
"There is still no confidence in this market and we need to have that before seeing strong gains," a local broker said.
At 0430 GMT, the Straits Times Industrials Index was up 2.97 points at 1,993.17. Investors were seen nibbling blue chips and selective property, banks and electronic stocks.
"Most houses are calling a slow and and selective accumulate on some stocks," said another broker.
Singapore Press Holdings Foreign rise S$0.40 to S$26.90.
Property stocks like City Developments and Cycle & Carriage rose after fears of new property curbs subsided. Foreign tranches of banks like OCBC, OUB and DBS were also underpinned.

More than 2.7 million Labroy Marine shares traded at S$1.81-1.83 since prices had fallen from earlier high of S$2.05. Shipping conglomerate Keppel Corp sank to new low of S$6.10 on over two million shares. Fund managers continued to shed the stock due to its poor prospects. Dealers said a local brokerage house had been appointed placement agent for shares of Advanced Systems Automation at about S$2.00 each. Market volume was about 54 million. -- Angela Tan (65 8703083)
